Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.combat

Class CombatResolver

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.combat.CombatResolver
public final class CombatResolver extends Object
The combat formulas. Resolving an attack changes the defender's HP and effects but produces no messages; see Combat for the version used during play.

Rules:

  1. Hit chance is 70% plus 5% per point of accuracy above the defender's evasion, limited to 5– 95%. A defender that is asleep or stunned is always hit.
  2. A hit is critical with the attack's crit chance (always, against a sleeping defender). Critical hits deal 1.5x damage and ignore armor.
  3. Damage is rolled in the attack's range and scaled by the attacker's weakness.
  4. Physical damage is reduced by a roll from 0 to the defender's armor.
  5. Immune defenders take no damage. A shield absorbs what it can.
  6. If damage got through, the attack's on-hit effect may take hold.
